qualification: Source-only implementation and behavioral tests written. No build, test, lint, formatting, native execution, SDK or camera run performed.

inputs.disassembly_tool: nix shell nixpkgs#pkgsCross.arm-embedded.buildPackages.binutils -c arm-none-eabi-objdump -D -b binary -m arm --adjust-vma=0x01100000 --start-address=START --stop-address=END IMAGE
inputs.preserved_tool_failure: Host objdump rejected machine arm. ARM cross-binutils from nix then decoded the stock input; host objdump failure is not target evidence.

facts: Start invokes initialization stages 0 and 1, then AP stage 2 or station stage 3 when stage equals 3; admission requires stage 4.
AP control precedes server DHCP startup. Station hardware address copy precedes station control.
Default station IPv4 configuration is 192.168.0.1 with mask 255.255.0.0.
Default address installation precedes polling operation 32, with 100-tick waits between failures.
Station ready polls operation 640 while the command enable flag remains zero.
Stop completes server/LAN teardown and clears WLAN control before notifying completion and publishing mode 1.
Server stop precedes transport format 1, LAN stages 2,1,0, and owner notification disable.
AP control installs 4000,20000,35000 control parameters; the network CPU does not duplicate radio control.
Client endpoint -1 does not schedule a timer; an active endpoint schedules its callback after 1000.
Server stop cancels lease timers and server timer before freeing leases, closing socket and detaching channel slots.
Hardware lookup admits nonzero IPv4 and six-byte destination, then copies hardware only on successful key lookup.
IPv4 checksum covers ten 16-bit header words with end-around carry.
The pinned file contains prototypes rather than implementations for network completion/control and socket dispatch functions. Those prototypes alone do not establish ordering or CPU behavior.
Calls 0x013e882c, then polls lease lookup 0x012fe7b8 with selector 0 and a 100-tick sleep each iteration.
A lease pointer publishes its word at +12 into 0x014bf634, formats four octets and publishes address display text.
A second 100-tick wait loop compares runtime channel word +0xb0 against the published address before return.
This function is a readiness wait, not a DHCP start consumer: it calls 0x01301260 with operation 640 and returns on success or nonzero 0x014bf5c8.
Stage 0 calls 0x0128ec78 then 0x0128eec4; stage 1 calls 0x012ad0c4; stage 2 invokes 0x0131d7fc and stage 3 invokes 0x0131d574.
A zero return from either stage 2/3 call publishes stage 4. Stage 1 loads two 13-word parameter banks from settings 0x9798..0x97b1.
Stages 2/3 call 0x0131d830 and transition 4 to 3; stage 1 calls 0x012ad1d4 and 0x012ad11c and transitions 3 to 2; stage 0 calls 0x0128efe8 when at stage 2, then 0x0128edd8 and transitions to 0.
Full stop invokes stages 2,1,0 and finally calls 0x012ad030 with zero.
A null channel returns 0xde. Otherwise it invokes 0x012ffd88, calls 0x01308b00 on channel+0x100 with count 1, invokes 0x0131c7dc and calls 0x01308958 on channel+0x100.

The actual socket constructor compares family r0 with 2 at 0x01317434. A non-2 family takes the branch at 0x0131743c, records error 0xf7, null socket and result -1, and jumps to completion at 0x0131758c before allocation.
Family 28 therefore fails even when accepted by a higher-level parser. No target IPv6 success is inferred from parser flags or protocol names.
Hardware key operation locates a route entry and rejects absent or unusable binding state before six-byte hardware copying.

owned_contract.entry: LanRuntime::start, receive, poll, stop, cancel, fail
owned_contract.station_admission: Composition owner calls start only after StationRuntime reaches Completed. EAPOL remains owned by station; LAN consumes Ethernet IPv4/ARP only.
owned_contract.physical_output: LanOutcome::Frame names an initialized Ethernet prefix in the caller output buffer. Composition owner submits that exact prefix through its concrete radio transport. Physical failure invokes fail before publishing service failure.
owned_contract.address_publication: Lease, route and ChannelLeases primary slot zero are installed synchronously before LanState::Ready is visible. A changed lease invalidates neighbors, sockets, fragments and pending output; renewal of the same lease preserves them. DHCP expiry or NAK withdraws the address, clears those consumers, and returns to Acquiring before emitting a discover.
owned_contract.stop_order: Stop server and client, clear transport and reassembly, invalidate UDP handles, discard pending packets, clear link and peer state, clear published lease, then publish Down.
owned_contract.dhcp: Existing DhcpServer and LeaseSlot engine reused. New DhcpClient owns discover/offer/request/ack/nak, server and transaction admission, option overload, renew/rebind/expiry and 1000ms transmission scheduling.
owned_contract.packets: Ethernet framing, ARP ownership and neighbor resolution, local-subnet/default-router routing, multicast mapping, pending packet transmission after ARP, existing UDP checksum/codec, bounded UDP socket receive/transmit queues. TCP and IPv4 reassembly are consumed from the separately owned transport module.
owned_contract.socket_options: bind_udp selects the owned IPv4 interface or a multicast destination; join_udp_multicast/leave_udp_multicast manage per-socket group ownership. set_udp_traffic_class writes the IPv4 traffic byte before checksum. set_udp_multicast_interface validates the selected owned interface and supplies the multicast source address. configure_tcp forwards typed SocketConfiguration to the concrete transport owner.
owned_contract.udp_receive: udp_received projects queued source/length without copying or consuming payload. receive_udp preserves the whole datagram on capacity failure. receive_udp_with_mode selects typed WholeDatagram or Truncate behavior; Truncate copies the available prefix, returns the copied length and consumes the entire datagram, including any discarded remainder.
owned_contract.socket_lifetime: Task87 consumes open_tcp_unbound without fabricating a port. connect_tcp_handle and listen_tcp_handle retain that canonical handle and delegate dynamic binding to TransportRuntime. Connect emits SYN; listen creates an owned listener. On listen failure the caller retains the handle for cancellation. open_tcp selects an explicit local port. open_udp_ephemeral uses the existing UDP socket table and selects an unused dynamic port; udp_local_endpoint exposes the assigned endpoint. No task-local socket engine is introduced.
owned_contract.multicast: Eight groups with bounded per-socket membership. IGMPv2 reports and leaves are emitted as ordinary routed IPv4 packets with TTL 1 and router alert; shared group membership leaves only after the final socket. General and group-specific queries queue reports, and received reports suppress pending reports. Multicast UDP is delivered only to joined sockets.
owned_contract.transport_module: The LAN facade declares vendor_wireless_network_transport.rs and consumes its concrete TCP/reassembly APIs and separate evidence.
owned_contract.service_composition: vendor_wireless_service owns the network86 queue/transition dispatcher, selected-interface control, radio/station setup and notification delivery. LAN does not export an opaque CPU callback for those operations. The service owns the serial transition lifecycle and pumps this runtime after station/AP setup.
owned_contract.dispatcher_byte_observation: 0x013e99b8..0x013e9be4 maps kinds 0x660b,0xe60b,0x6600,0x6601,0x6602,0x6603,0x6606,0x660c,0x662a,0x660d,0x660e,0x6609,0x660a to indices 0..12, or 13 otherwise, before calling 0x013e98f8 with zero. 0x013e9c0c..0x013e9c3c receives queue 0x56 and dispatches each message. 0x013ebba0..0x013ebbe0 chooses call 0x013edbcc versus 0x013ef2f0 using word +0xd4 at 0x014c1010 and forwards the incoming kind.
owned_contract.limits: Eight UDP sockets, eight TCP socket slots, 2048-byte socket buffers, four 4096-byte fragment slots, sixteen neighbors, eight multicast groups and one 4096-byte pending routed packet. Capacity and backpressure are typed results; no heap, raw stock pointer, scalar CPU callback or firmware trampoline.

intentional_redesign: The stock address propagation busy-wait is replaced with one synchronous owned address/route/lease publication. No external CPU is asked to finish address installation.
The caller receives typed state and lease data rather than stock global addresses or display-string pointers.
Typed errors replace stock unbounded array and packet accesses. Socket generation checks reject handles invalidated by close, stop or address loss.

The packet, DHCP client and IGMPv2 implementations follow the owned wire/state contract. The inspected target spans establish integration and teardown dependencies, not instruction-equivalence for every option, routing decision or multicast timer.
One interface owns its connected route and default router. It does not reproduce the stock multi-channel route tree or its memory representation.
Owned ephemeral UDP ports are selected sequentially from 49152..65535 with live-port collision exclusion. This is an owned allocation policy, not a stock port-sequence equivalence claim.
behavioral_tests_written_unrun: Full AP/server to station DHCP Ethernet exchange and coherent address publication.
Stop invalidates UDP handles, clears published lease and rejects late packets.
Unresolved UDP transmission emits ARP then sends the preserved payload after resolution.
Small socket receive output leaves the datagram queued.
DHCP renew, rebind, expiration and stopped-client late reply rejection.
Routing uses the default router for a remote subnet and broadcast hardware for subnet broadcast.
ARP reply ownership, neighbor learning and address-change invalidation.
Station start capacity failure leaves state Down.
DHCP server restart clears the previous lease owner.
DHCP discovery timer handles millisecond wrap and stop disarms further transmissions.
Stopped AP rejects late peer completion without republishing peers.
Per-socket multicast membership gates UDP delivery and outgoing traffic class is checksummed.
Shared multicast membership emits IGMP leave only after the last socket.
Ephemeral UDP ports exclude live bindings and outgoing packets use the assigned source endpoint.
Unbound TCP retains its handle through connect, acquires a dynamic port and is invalidated by LAN stop.
Unbound TCP listeners acquire distinct ephemeral bindings without fabricating fixed local ports.
UDP readiness metadata does not consume payload; truncating 1470 bytes into a 52-byte receive buffer returns 52 and discards the remainder.
